name: 5-MeO-DET
summary: 5-MeO-DET, also known as 5-methoxy-N,N-diethyltryptamine is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to 5-MeO-DMT. It is taken orally but can also be used parenterally.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-DET inhibits serotonin reuptake with an IC50 value of 2,400 nM and activates the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor with an EC50 value of 8.1 nM. The drug fully substitutes for DOM in rodent drug discrimination tests. It also substitutes for 5-MeO-DMT in rodent drug discrimination tests. In addition, 5-MeO-DET produces the head-twitch response in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

body.says: Oral: 20–30 minutes; Smoking: A few minutes

uses.text: It is taken orally but can also be used parenterally. The drug produces strong side effects such as lightheadedness, dizziness, and vertigo at low doses that prevent hallucinogenic doses from being tolerated or used. The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in 2005.

sideEffects.text: The drug produces strong side effects such as lightheadedness, dizziness, and vertigo at low doses that prevent hallucinogenic doses from being tolerated or used.

fact.en: It fully substitutes for the psychedelic DOM in animal tests, yet in people the dizziness and lightheadedness it causes arrive before any psychedelic effect, so it never became popular.
fact.zh: 在動物測試中，它能完全替代迷幻藥DOM；但在人體上，它造成的頭暈與暈眩在任何迷幻作用之前就先出現，因此始終沒有流行起來。
fact.zhHans: 在动物测试中，它能完全替代迷幻药DOM；但在人体上，它造成的头晕与晕眩在任何迷幻作用之前就先出现，因此始终没有流行起来。
